subject: Entitlement curation checkpoint — SOC 2 intake
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Liam Chen <liam.chen@pinebrook.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 07 Apr 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Entitlement curation checkpoint — SOC 2 intake

Hi Liam —

Thanks again for taking the time yesterday. To keep our SOC 2 intake tight, we'd like to run a short entitlement curation exercise focused on SSO/SAML, SCIM provisioning, and RBAC ownership. The goal is to deliver a scoped matrix and a 30-day SCIM delta + SAML assertion sample for the auditors.

What we need from Pinebrook:
- A completed entitlement CSV using the attached template (roles, human vs service account, owner)
- SCIM delta logs (30-day window; see the sample spec we prefer) or a short export if SCIM is not centrally logged
- One SAML assertion (sample) for a user who exercises at least two different role bindings

We can take a 60-minute sync this week to walk through the template if helpful. Proposed timeline: intake by Apr 13, sample logs by Apr 18, deliverable handoff Apr 21. If those dates don't work, tell us what does.

Attachment: entitlement-matrix-template.csv

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Security & Trust
Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

From: Liam Chen <liam.chen@pinebrook.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Pinebrook Health SOC <soc@pinebrook.com>
Date: Wed, 07 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Entitlement curation checkpoint — SOC 2 intake

Naomi —

Appreciate the clear ask. Quick questions before we complete the CSV:
1) For 'owner' do you want a single owner per role or allow joint owners?
2) Do you consider delegated service accounts (those issued by an internal tooling team) as 'service accounts' for this matrix?
3) SCIM logs: we can produce a delta export from our IdP (Okta) but it contains a lot of metadata. Is a CSV with timestamp, user_id, operation, and role_id OK, or do you need the raw JSON?

I'm attaching a small sample we pulled to show the format we have. We'll aim to get the full CSV by Apr 14 if that works.

Attachment: pinebrook-scim-sample.csv

Cheers,
Liam Chen
Head of Information Security
Pinebrook Health
liam.chen@pinebrook.com

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>, Liam Chen <liam.chen@pinebrook.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 08 Apr 2027 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Entitlement curation checkpoint — SOC 2 intake

Liam / Naomi —

Quick clarifications from the ops side so our auditors are not blocked:
- Owner: prefer a single canonical owner per role in the matrix; if there are joint owners, add a secondary_owner column.
- Service accounts: include delegated tooling accounts and label them in the 'account_type' column. This helps with sampling.
- SCIM logs: the CSV you described (timestamp,user_id,operation,role_id,actor) should be fine. If possible include an "entitlement_hash" or human-readable role name.
- SAML assertion: we need a full assertion (XML), but you may redact PII — auditors need the assertion structure, audience, and attributes.

I've pasted a minimal sample spec below for the SCIM export and attached a short spec file with the fields we typically parse. If Pinebrook can deliver a 30-day delta in CSV, our team will ingest and pick a representative sample for the auditors.

Attachment: scim-log-sample-spec.txt

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Senior Product Manager, Security
Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Liam Chen <liam.chen@pinebrook.com>, Pinebrook Health SOC <soc@pinebrook.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 09 Apr 2027 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Entitlement curation checkpoint — SOC 2 intake

Liam —

Thanks for the speedy follow-up and for the sample. That plan works. Finalized mutual action plan below so we have clear owners and dates:

MUTUAL ACTION PLAN
- Pinebrook: complete entitlement CSV (single owner preferred; secondary_owner optional) — due Apr 14 — owner: Liam Chen
- Pinebrook: export SCIM delta (30-day window) in CSV (timestamp,user_id,operation,role_id,actor,readable_role) — due Apr 18 — owner: SOC team
- Pinebrook: provide one redacted SAML assertion (XML) showing a multi-role user — due Apr 18 — owner: Liam Chen
- Redwood: ingest artifacts, validate role mapping, surface any gaps — deliverable Apr 21 — owner: Jonas Weber

If those dates change, flag us immediately. We'll reserve Apr 22 for a short auditor-facing walk-through if you prefer.

We'll create a shared Drive folder and a HubSpot ticket under deal D-83741 — I'll drop links once created. Thanks again — we'll keep this narrow to avoid extra work on your side.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Security & Trust
Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com
